source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Castlederg rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. There were no contests: ten Unionists and six Nationalists were returned unopposed. R. K. Henderson was the only new member, for Castlederg in place of John McAskie. Returned unopposed.
